resources.string: Klean stays quiet while you sleep. Check-ins wait until you\'re up.

Keys will be stored unencrypted in the backup file.
Saves a backup to a folder you choose.
Replace everything on this phone? This deletes the %1$s, photos and settings currently in Klean and replaces them with the backup from %2$s (%3$s, %4$s). This can\'t be undone.
The backup couldn\'t be saved. Try another place.

AI can fill in details about what you log. Logging always works without it, and nothing is sent anywhere until you switch a provider on.
Google\'s model, over the internet. Needs an API key.
A server you run, such as Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible service.
A small model that runs on this phone. Works offline and nothing leaves the phone.
A small language model runs on this phone. It works offline and nothing you log leaves the phone. It is slower and less accurate than an online service, and it needs about 600 MB of storage.
Use the model on this phone for the tasks you pick in AI providers.
No model on this phone yet.
A .litertlm file. The default is Qwen3 0.6B. Downloads over Wi-Fi only.
Already downloaded one, for example Gemma from Hugging Face? Pick the .litertlm file and Klean copies it.
Loading the model and asking about \"toast with butter\". The first time can take a minute.
Get a model and switch it on first.

The server wouldn\'t give out that file. Some models need a login; download those in a browser and choose the file here.
